# origincloud_iam_federated_credential (Resource)

A `WORKLOAD` service account's trust in an identity provider's OIDC tokens that carry the given claims.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (Map of String) The claims a token must carry, each with exactly this value, such as `repository_id` and `environment` for GitHub Actions. At least one, on an identity that never changes. Changing it replaces the federated credential.
- `display_name` (String) A name of your own, shown in the console; at most 100 characters. Changing it replaces the federated credential.
- `issuer` (String) The identity provider whose tokens are trusted: a token's `iss`, matched exactly, an `https` URL that serves `/.well-known/openid-configuration`, such as `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`. Changing it replaces the federated credential.
- `organization` (String) The organization the federated credential is in. Changing it replaces the federated credential.
- `service_account` (String) The service account the federated credential is in. Changing it replaces the federated credential.

### Optional

- `audience` (String) The audience a token must be issued for, its `aud`, matched exactly; `https://sts.origincloudapis.eu` when the create leaves it empty. Changing it replaces the federated credential.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the federated credential was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) Who created the federated credential, written as a role binding's member is.
- `delete_time` (String) When the federated credential was deleted; unset while it is active. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `id` (String) The federated credential's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The federated credential's resource name.
- `state` (String) Where the federated credential is in its lifecycle. One of `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`.
